True alpha transparent background and completely transparent hollow center; no ground patch, filled disk, background, shadow plane, checkerboard, text, watermark or characters. Hand-painted stylized game energy, readable broad shapes, restrained bloom, not photoreal. Near/front rim slightly more substantial, rear/top rim slightly thinner, indicating depth. Keep central area empty for enemy visibility. ONE isolated still texture, no contact sheet; animation will be handled in-engine. Subject: HASTE WIND AURA. Golden wind ribbons sweeping around the elliptical perimeter, two small feather tips integrated tangentially into the rim; gold, amber, cream. Near rim broad, back rim delicate. Lightweight flowing energy, not fire. Completely hollow alpha center, clear surrounding margin. Preserve the painterly polish of the input but substantially reduce its thick band.
